sections.title: Conduct
lines: English in chat and on Discord. Be civil. Staff decisions are final; appeal in #support.
Chat and commands are logged for moderation and kept for the season; the log is deleted with the season world. Chat is also mirrored to Discord #minecraft-chat and stays there.
A bought nickname never imitates a player, staff or the Board; staff reset it.

sections.title: Accounts
lines: One account per player. A second account on the same connection gets no starting capital.
Two accounts farming credits, contracts or referrals is an exploit: three-day ban at least, payouts reversed.
The Board keeps a salted fingerprint of your first-login connection for the season (starting capital and referral checks); it is deleted with the season world.

sections.title: Economy and exploits
lines: Credits are paid by the Board only: deliveries, quests, events and referrals. They are never traded, sold or bought.
No dupes. Found a bug? Do not use it, report it in #support. The Board thanks reporters with a cosmetic title, never with credits.
No automated mob farms and no resource made from nothing.

sections.title: World and claims
lines: The world border is 3,000 blocks from the centre and may grow later. The Nether is fenced at 375 blocks.
Claim your chunks. No theft, no grief, and no pipe, hopper or machine reaching into another crew's claim.
Chunk loading only through the Board's paid loaders. No portal chunk loading.

sections.title: PvP and events
lines: PvP only in the HQ arena during events (Friday Zone, invasions). No camping at HQ.
Graves keep every item. Death costs 95 % of your XP and waystones charge XP: sleep, set a waystone.

sections.title: Staff
lines: Only the owner uses creative mode. Support ranks are cosmetic only.
Staff may look at inventories and logs, never take. The ban ladder is in the staff charter.

sections.title: Season
lines: 84 days. The end date is public from day 1.
What carries over to Season 2 is announced early.
